caption: The drawing depicts a single figure of a doll with pale skin and black hair styled in a center part and waves, wearing a dress with horizontal and vertical stripes in green, white, and red. The doll has defined facial features including dark eyebrows, eyes, a small nose, and pink lips. The dress has a fitted bodice with puffed sleeves and a full, flared skirt, with prominent striping that alternates between the three colors. The doll’s arms are slightly bent at the elbows and its hands are visible. The legs are straight and the feet are angled outward, and the doll’s arms and legs appear jointed. The background is plain and off-white, and there is a handwritten signature reading “Mary Humes” in the lower right corner.
title: Doll and Costume
